name: Quicken Simplifi
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. The hard boundary is bank aggregation, transaction cleaning, mobile sync, support, and mature finance workflows, plus financial integrations, compliance, and trust.
